tiers.name: Standalone 7B Draft Model Sharded Across TP=8 (280 Tiny All-Reduces / Cycle)
tiers.note: 5 draft steps x 28 layers x 2 All-Reduces = 280 tiny latency-bound NVLink syncs (11.8ms draft + 14.4ms verify = 26.2ms / 3.1 tok = 8.45ms, barely 1.33x)!

tiers.name: Disaggregated Standalone Draft GPU Pool Over Network RPC
tiers.note: Network serialization + KV state sync between Target and Draft nodes every 20ms adds 6.3ms RPC jitter, slowing effective TPOT to 9.32ms!

tiers.name: EAGLE-1/2 1-Layer Feature Head (Top-Layer Hidden State Only, Full 128K Vocab)
tiers.note: Replaces 28-layer 7B draft with 1-layer feature head (2.40ms for 5 steps), reaching 3.85 accepted tokens and 4.36ms effective TPOT (2.57x).

tiers.name: EAGLE-3 (Low/Mid/High Feature Fusion + 32K Freq Vocab + Joint 5-Step CUDAGraph)
tiers.note: Fuses multi-layer features + training-time test (4.85 accepted tokens) and trims draft LM Head to Top-32K vocab inside 1 CUDAGraph (1.15ms draft, 3.21ms TPOT = 3.49x)!
